checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Open empty hands reach overhead and alternate small lifts above the mat.
checks.feet: Prone trunk remains stable while each straight leg lifts with the opposite arm.
checks.movement: Lie prone with arms reaching overhead and legs long. Alternate raising each arm with the opposite leg while keeping torso steady; limbs hover and knees/elbows stay extended. Two controlled alternating cycles in eight seconds.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
